inspection_kind: Standard-library ZIP/class-file structural inspection only; no Java/Gradle/provider/class execution or network.

behavior.value_normalization: Untrimmed Properties.getProperty value; no case conversion.
behavior.computed_digest: SHA-256; each unsigned byte uses Integer.toHexString, padded with ASCII zero when length is one.
behavior.absent_declaration: Null expected checksum returns before verification.
behavior.cached_path: No runtime inference; a separate independent exact owner path receipt must establish required comparison or cached-without-comparison.

version_provenance: Local exact consumer artifact identity/behavior only. Actual selected Gradle9.6.1 wrapper and distribution provenance must be independently owner-attested, not inferred from distribution URL/name.
